senses.gloss: throwing (a stone &c.). Y. B. Kam. III, 3ᶜ top אם כדרך ה׳ הטיח if one hit (him who was carrying a flask) in the way of throwing a stone (not merely by letting a stone lie in the road).

units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 6:9:9">Y. Sabb. VI, 8ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>דומה … ה׳ זו בלבד</he> it seems that I am not to carry off from this place anything except this contusion (of my finger).
